founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Brian leads business development at Oklo (YC S14), a company delivering reliable, low-cost, clean energy through advanced nuclear power plants. Brian has founded and led multiple clean energy organizations, including UtilityScore (YC S16) software startup that estimated utility costs and savings for 100M+ homes. He has also served as CEO of a clean energy consulting firm and led business development at Reach Labs (YC S15) a hard tech wireless power company.
